scenes.heading: Keep each client's goals where you'll see them

sents.d: Keep each client's goals where you'll see them
Without the original goals in front of you, sessions drift toward whatever happened that week.
Two months of putting out fires can pass without the hired goal moving at all.
And then progress is hard to show.

scenes.heading: Goals at the top, read monthly

sents.d: Put each client's goals at the top of their notes file in their own words, with a date.
Review them together once a month and rewrite the goal if it has genuinely changed.

take: Goals at the top of the file, reviewed together once a month.
